Phys."],"accepted":{"date-parts":[[2019,6,4]]},"abstract":"<jats:p>A sharp version of the information paradox involves a seeming\nviolation of the monogamy of entanglement during black hole evaporation.\nWe construct an analogous paradox in empty anti-de Sitter space. In a\nlocal quantum field theory, Bell correlations between operators\nlocalized in mutually spacelike regions are monogamous. We show, through\na controlled calculation, that this property can be violated by an\norder-1 factor in a theory of gravity. This example demonstrates that\nwhat appears to be a violation of the monogamy of entanglement may just\nbe a subtle violation of locality in quantum
